nodes.name: ua-import-map-input.json
nodes.summary: Intermediate input payload for the import-map extraction step of the Understand-Anything analysis pipeline, listing the project root and the file list to resolve imports for.

nodes.name: ua-import-map-output.json
nodes.summary: Intermediate output of the import-map extraction script, containing completion status, stats, and the resolved project-internal import graph used to seed batchImportData for downstream file analysis.

nodes.name: ua-scan-files.json
nodes.summary: Intermediate output of the project file scanner, enumerating all discovered project files with metadata (language, size, category) plus aggregate stats like total file count and estimated complexity.
